description: This file contains utility functions for managing service worker communication and stream saving, including keep-alive pings, posting messages to the service worker, and registration logic within the Notesnook project.

methods.name: keepAlive
methods.description: Maintains a keep-alive ping to the service worker by periodically sending a 'PING' message or fetching a ping URL.

methods.name: postMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to the service worker with download data, setting up message channels and URL validation.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Starts the keep-alive process for the service worker.

methods.name: findServiceWorker
methods.description: Finds the active service worker registration and scope.
